parts: In a moment I had the office and the night editor’s desk, had told him who I was, and began to dictate. “At

by our time (see what time Paris time is for that, and put it in) a French battleship was sunk by the man who is to stop all war. Probably no one on board escaped.” That last was a guess based on the experience of the past.
title: The Man Who Ended War
author: Hollis Godfrey
